_description: [Legacy] Simple/minimal EB 100D LOO + train-on-all configs (DMSB paper comparison) that were superseded by configs/singlecell/100DLOO/. These bring only holdout_times + eval_num_samples on top of singlecell/defaults.json. The polished per-condition configs in 100DLOO/ override more knobs (strength=300, width=0.3, otp_alpha_mean_scale=0.3, grad_clip=1.0, longer epochs for t1/t3) and are what the multi-dataset experiments use. This folder was previously named 5DL2O; renamed for accuracy. This file is not loaded directly.
